scene: Soft seamless studio background; choose its setting and colors from the product analysis visual direction, never copy reference colors
composition: Keep the product prominent and fully visible; adapt negative space and factual text zones to the analysis idea and selected card scenario
lighting: Soft diffused studio light, natural contact shadow and depth; preserve the real product color
style: Clean professional marketplace photography; restrained readable typography when supported by product facts
avoid: invented product facts, prices or benefits
changes to source product geometry, colors, branding or labels
